name: AITraining.jobs
description: Searches open AI-training jobs — trainers, RLHF evaluators, annotators, domain experts — collected hourly from about 60 platform boards, with advertised pay and median rates by work type.

skills.name: Search AI training jobs
skills.description: Searches live AI-training roles by keyword, platform, work kind, pay band or location, returning listing dates and direct role URLs.

skills.name: Get training pay rates
skills.description: Returns advertised pay bands and median rates for AI-training work, broken out by work type across the tracked platform boards.

skills.name: Get training market stats
skills.description: Reports aggregate market figures for AI-training work: total open roles, counts by platform and work kind, and recent listing activity.
